scenes.score_intent: Gothic psychological horror underscore, low strings and sparse piano in a dim minor key, opening hushed and oppressive around 70 BPM with a nervous pulse under the confessional address, gradually thickening with dissonant mid-register strings and a thin high harmonic as the narrator insists he is not mad, tempo and tension climb through the middle as he describes disease-sharpened senses and acute hearing with subtle metallic overtones and heartbeat-like low percussion, peaking in a taut sustained string cluster on the claim that he hears all things in heaven and earth, then easing back to a calmer but still uneasy persuasive hush with restrained cello as he invites the listener to hearken, never fully resolving
scenes.dynamics_arc: Intensity rises from clip 1 through clips 2–3, holds a sustained peak across clips 4–7 on the sharpened senses and hearing, then releases on clip 8 into forced calm.
scenes.timing: Continuous underscore across ~45s; swell through mid-scene hearing monologue; soft landing on final calm delivery
scenes.diegetic_sound: Faint old-house creaks, distant wood settling, subtle room tone of a shuttered corridor; no crowd or street noise
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Avoid melodic heroism, bright major keys, and any cheerful resolution; keep percussion minimal until later scenes
alternatives: Solo low clarinet and dry strings only
Almost silent bed of room tone with occasional dissonant piano stabs

scenes.score_intent: Dark chamber horror cue, very sparse at first with near-silence and a single low drone under the pitch-dark bedroom, tempo slow around 60–75 BPM, idea-motif enters as a quiet obsessive repeating figure on muted strings and prepared piano as the murderous thought is conceived and begins to haunt, remaining cool and passionless through the denial of gold and insult, then darkening sharply in the final third with a cold high string scrape and sinking bass as the vulture eye is named, blood-running-cold stinger without full orchestral explosion
scenes.dynamics_arc: Starts minimal on clip 1, rises through clips 2–3 as the idea takes hold, dips slightly on clips 4–5, then peaks hard on clip 6 with the eye revelation.
scenes.timing: Sparse open, obsessive motif mid-scene, cold stinger in final seconds on the eye
scenes.diegetic_sound: Heavy silence of fastened shutters, faint breath of sleeping old man, wood bed creak, no exterior night life
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No romantic or sentimental strings on 'I loved the old man'; no treasure-glitter sparkle cues
alternatives: Only sub-bass drone and intermittent high harmonic
Music box warped into minor for the haunting idea

scenes.score_intent: Daylight mask of kindness over the same gothic palette: warmer but slightly false major-tinged chamber strings and soft woodwinds at a gentle walking tempo around 80 BPM, polite and hearty on the surface as morning light enters and the narrator greets the old man, never fully shedding a thin uneasy undercurrent in the low strings so the kindness feels performed, remaining modest and restrained without climax, fading politely as he withdraws
scenes.dynamics_arc: Gentle rise into clip 2 on the hearty greeting, then soft plateau and slight release through clips 3–4.
scenes.timing: Brief ~25s cue; light swell on entrance and greeting only
scenes.diegetic_sound: Soft morning room tone, unshuttered light ambience, floorboards under bold footsteps, old man’s frail bed shift
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No night-horror drones or heartbeat; avoid irony stingers that telegraph the lie too hard
alternatives: Solo warm cello with faint dissonant aftertaste
Near-diegetic silence with only light domestic ambience

scenes.score_intent: Stealth thriller underscore, extremely quiet and meticulous, slow tempo near 50–60 BPM built from held string harmonics, soft leather-friction textures, and barely-there timpani skin, tension ratchets as the latch turns and the door cracks, building through a long controlled crescendo of close-miked creaks and tightening dissonant intervals while the head and closed lantern take an hour to enter, peaking on a proud cold wisdom motif—still hushed, never loud—as he boasts a madman would not be so wise, precision over volume throughout
scenes.dynamics_arc: Clip 1 establishes taut quiet, clip 2 raises stakes at midnight latch, clips 3–5 sustain the highest stealth intensity through the slow head entry and wise-madman boast.
scenes.timing: Long slow build across ~35s matching the hour-long head placement; peak late without a crash
scenes.diegetic_sound: Metal latch turning oh-so-gently, aged door fiber creak, tin lantern scrape, narrator’s controlled breath
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No sudden hits, no full orchestra, no melody that breaks stealth; exclude any heartbeat yet
alternatives: Pure foley-led tension with only a single sustained cello harmonic
Clockwork-slow pizzicato pulse under the latch work

scenes.score_intent: Ritual night cue, hushed gothic suspense at slow tempo, thin high strings and a cautious hinge-creak motif as the lantern is undone and a single ray falls, brief tense peak on the creak and ray, then flattening into frustrated stasis and hollow unresolved chords when the eye remains closed and the work is impossible, seven-nights sense of repetition suggested by a circling minor ostinato that never resolves, withdrawing into near silence with the lantern
scenes.dynamics_arc: Clip 1 medium tension on the sleeping figure, peaks on clip 2 lantern undo and creak, then settles lower through clips 3–5 on the failed ritual and Evil Eye motive.
scenes.timing: Peak early-mid on lantern open; long quiet tail for the seven-night impossibility
scenes.diegetic_sound: Lantern hinge creak once, thin mechanical click, sleeping breath, door closing without sound
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No triumph, no eye-open stinger; keep ray moment delicate not shocking
alternatives: Ostinato only on muted viola
Almost no score—hinge creak and breath carry the scene

scenes.score_intent: Return of the false-daylight kindness cue, soft chamber warmth and gentle tempo around 80 BPM, bold but light entrance music with polite woodwind courtesy over a barely audible uneasy bass, hearty inquiry colored as sincere, remaining modest and unsuspicious through the profound-old-man irony, no build to horror, clean polite fade as daytime reassurance closes
scenes.dynamics_arc: Slight lift on clip 2 greeting, otherwise even and low across clips 1, 3, and 4.
scenes.timing: Short ~25s; small swell only on the morning inquiry
scenes.diegetic_sound: Daybreak room tone, bold footsteps, bedclothes rustle, ordinary domestic quiet
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No carry-over of night stealth drones; no foreshadowing stingers
alternatives: Same motif as S3 slightly thinner
Diegetic-only morning ambience with no score

scenes.score_intent: Eighth-night escalation of stealth horror, slower than a watch hand, ultra-controlled low strings and suppressed breath rhythm around 45–55 BPM, private triumph enters as a stifled chuckle-colored woodwind flicker over mounting power, tension stays high as the door pushes steadily into pitch black, then spikes in the final moments with a sharp metallic slip accent on the tin fastening—dry, close, startling but not yet the murder climax—leaving a frozen held dissonance into the next scene
scenes.dynamics_arc: Opens already high on clips 1–2 extreme caution and power, dips slightly on clips 3–4 chuckle and bed startle, climbs again on clip 5 steady push, peaks on clip 6 thumb slip.
scenes.timing: Continuous high tension ~40s; sharp accent in last seconds on lantern slip
scenes.diegetic_sound: Latch slower than a minute hand, suppressed chuckle, bed movement, tin fastening slip click, pitch-dark room silence
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: No full yell or heartbeat tattoo yet; save orchestral explosion for S8
alternatives: Breath and foley only until the metallic slip stinger
Sub-bass power drone with single piano slip note

scenes.score_intent: Full Tell-Tale Heart murder climax score in gothic orchestral horror: opens on a sudden frozen silence after the old man’s cry, then a long almost-still hour of terror with only a low dread drone, stifled groans colored by distant mournful strings, and Death’s shadow as a cold expanding cluster; spider-thread ray on the open Evil Eye brings a piercing high sustained tone and rising fury; introduce a muffled heartbeat tattoo—low drum or muted timpani wrapped in cotton—that starts quiet and slow then quickens and loudens like a war drum through the middle third, driving tempo from near-stillness up past 120 BPM; fury crest breaks into a violent full orchestral hit and brass-scream stab as the narrator yells and throws the lantern open, chaotic percussion and shrieking strings through the leap, single shriek, and smothering under the bed; after the kill, music collapses to a ghastly relieved gaiety—thin major flicker over residual muffled heartbeats that gradually slow and cease—ending on hollow near-silence and a final cold unresolved string as the eye will trouble him no more
scenes.dynamics_arc: Clip 1 shock peak on “Who’s there?”, sustained high dread through clips 2–10 stillness and listening, eye-open spike on clip 11, heartbeat-driven climb through clips 12–17, absolute climax on clips 18–19 yell and murder, then release through clips 20–22 as the heart ceases and death is confirmed.
scenes.timing: Long ~150s arc: freeze and hour-long creep, heartbeat acceleration mid-to-late, explosive hit on yell/lantern/leap, extended decay after death
scenes.diegetic_sound: Old man cry “Who’s there?”, bed creaks, stifled groan, lantern crevice open, muffled heartbeat growing, loud yell, single shriek, bed dragged and dropped, residual muffled beats dying out, final silence of the chamber
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: Preserve true stillness in the hour-long freeze—no busy scoring; do not romanticize the kill; cut heroic or redemptive tones after death; heartbeat must feel diegetic then merge with score
alternatives: Heartbeat-only engine under sparse strings until the yell stinger
Full orchestra from eye-open onward with choir cluster on the smothering

scenes.score_intent: Dark gothic psychological horror underscore, sparse low strings, muted bass clarinet and dry wooden ticks at a hushed 70 BPM, clinical and methodical rather than gory, opens nearly silent under lantern-lit labor, stays restrained and surgical through the dismemberment and plank work with only thin dissonant harmonics, warms into a brief sly self-satisfied swell of low strings and a soft ironic chuckle-color on the cunning board replacement and tub ha-ha, then thins to cold near-silence broken by a distant four-o'clock bell partial and a hollow remote door-knock motif
scenes.dynamics_arc: Restrained dread holds through clips 1-4, rises to a quiet smug peak at clips 5-6, then releases into sparse unease at clip 7.
scenes.timing: Sparse bed under full ~60s; slight swell only on board-replacement and ha-ha third; cut thin before distant bell and knock
scenes.diegetic_sound: lantern hiss, soft wet cutting implied not lingered, plank scrapes, boards seating flush, tub drip, distant bell toll, firm street-door knocking below
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no melodic themes, no jump-scare stingers, no lush romance strings; keep blood work dry and unsensational
alternatives: solo prepared piano with body-tap rhythms
almost-silent foley bed with only sub-bass dread tone

scenes.score_intent: Period gothic night underscore, restrained strings and soft low piano at a deceptively calm 80 BPM, opens sparse and pre-dawn cold on the heavy street door, brightens into false lightness and ordered composure as the narrator descends with a light heart, stays suave and controlled under the officers' entrance and the dream-excuse, firms into confident inviting resolve on search-search well without ever dropping the thin undercurrent of dread
scenes.dynamics_arc: Low nocturnal open at clip 1, lifts with false ease through clips 2-4, peaks on confident invitation at clips 5-6.
scenes.timing: Gentle rise across ~40s; brightest and firmest in final third on the invitation to search
scenes.diegetic_sound: heavy period door unlatch and creak, night street hush, footsteps on stair, officers' calm entry, coat cloth and boot scuffs
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no triumphant fanfare, no comedy cues; keep politeness slightly uncanny
alternatives: solo clarinet and pizzicato bass, courtly but hollow
drone-free quiet with only door and foot foley plus faint harmonic pad

scenes.score_intent: Quiet gothic house-tour underscore, soft sustained strings and muted harp at a composed walking 75 BPM, confident and almost serene as the narrator leads officers through corridors and undisturbed rooms, singular ease in the harmony with only a hairline of unresolved dissonance beneath, gently settles softer as the officers remain convinced and at ease
scenes.dynamics_arc: Steady moderate ease through clips 1-2, soft release as conviction settles at clip 3.
scenes.timing: Even bed across ~30s; slight soften in final third when officers look convinced
scenes.diegetic_sound: corridor footsteps, lantern or candle soft move, door latches, quiet room tone, officers' measured steps
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no suspense stingers, no heartbeat yet, no sharp accents; avoid telegraphing later breakdown
alternatives: solo viola long tones with soft wood creaks
near-silent ambient house tone only

scenes.score_intent: Psychological gothic horror score in one continuous arc: opens with polite restrained chamber strings and low woodwinds at a calm 70 BPM as officers are seated in wild audacity of triumph above the corpse, a low dull quick heartbeat-like timpani tattoo enters softly and grows more distinct and relentless beneath forced cheer, tempo and density climb through the middle as strings turn dissonant and agitated and the narrator pales and gasps, builds into frantic pacing figures, foaming brass stabs and grating chair-drag percussion through the raving, then explodes into a shattering fortissimo orchestral confession hit on villains dissemble no more and tear up the planks, then cuts abruptly to stunned near-silence with only a dying heartbeat echo under the officers' freeze
scenes.dynamics_arc: Controlled triumph clips 1-3, mounting ringing dread clips 4-6, escalating breakdown clips 7-11, absolute peak confession clips 12-13, collapse to stunned quiet clip 14.
scenes.timing: Slow fuse first third of ~90s, steady climb second third, full detonation final third then hard cut to near silence on freeze
scenes.diegetic_sound: chair legs on boards, pleasant officer chatter underscored then ignored, narrator breath and gasp, heavy pacing strides, chair swing and grate on floorboards, final shrieking confession, sudden room freeze silence
scenes.silence_or_exclusions: no score after confession hit beyond dying heartbeat echo; officers must seem to hear nothing until the end; avoid generic jump stingers before the true peak
alternatives: heartbeat-centric percussion ensemble with strings only at climax
minimal piano cluster build into full orchestra scream then silence
